claim.purpose: Permit exact reserved-claim activation from its registered existing issue worktree

initial.title: Activate an exact reserved claim from its existing issue worktree
initial.goal: Restore a legal typed bind path for a prepared claim whose registered worktree already exists.
initial.required_outcome: An exact reserved claim can activate from its matching existing Git worktree without writing lifecycle state on main.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Existing matching branch and canonical worktree path activate the exact reserved claim
AC-2: Mismatched claimed branch or worktree path fails closed
AC-3: Exact claim, collision, path-safety, and readiness guards remain enforced
AC-4: The #5306 recovery can bind without editing main or lifecycle JSON by hand
initial.failure_policy: Fail closed unless the exact claim, current branch, and canonical registered worktree all agree.
initial.plan_summary: Recognize the exact registered existing worktree as issue-local, preserve bind guards, and prove match and mismatch behavior.

steps.action: Implement existing-worktree bind recognition and regressions

validation_lanes.proof_role: Typed binding and fail-closed path identity

review_prompts: Does issue-local recognition require both the exact branch and canonical registered worktree path?
Are all existing bind guards preserved?
risks: Loose path matching could activate a claim from the wrong checkout.
stop_conditions: Any need to hand-edit rendered cards
Any relaxation of exact claim or collision checks
initial.task_boundary: Implement only exact existing-worktree recognition for typed bind and focused regressions.
